date_note: Date of the prime minister's statement as reported by VOV on 20 November; the bill's first-reading vote is reported as 17 November.
exec: France is raising security standards for state systems; a bill would extend security obligations to thousands of firms and public bodies.
plain: French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu says the cyber threat is at an exceptionally serious level and the state will tighten security standards for its information systems.
summary: VOV reports that French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu said on 19 November the cyber threat is at an exceptionally serious level and the government will tighten security standards for state information systems. VOV also reports that the National Assembly passed a first reading on 17 November of a bill extending security obligations to thousands of firms and public bodies, with more ANSSI inspection and incident-response powers.
title: France to tighten security standards for state systems; cyber bill passes first reading

validation.note: Single source: VOV's report of the prime minister's statement and the bill; the original French government statement was not read.
